name: Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A.
summary: Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A., established in 1989 and headquartered in Kraków, Poland, operates a diverse business model encompassing real estate and an array of commercial and industrial services. Primarily, the company specializes in leasing and renting various properties, including commercial units. Beyond its real estate focus, it delivers a broad spectrum of services such as business and management consulting, advertising, and other commercial endeavors. The company also demonstrates a commitment to environmental initiatives, offering design and advisory services for ecological protection and investing in pro-environmental projects. Financially, Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A. is active in the financial instruments market. Its commercial activities extend internationally, covering wholesale and retail trade in foreign markets, alongside the import and export of goods and services. It also functions as a commercial broker, facilitating commodity sales and stock exchange transactions. Furthermore, the company manages warehousing facilities and provides stock exchange management services. Its operational scope includes comprehensive transport, forwarding, reloading, and repair services. A key part of its enterprise involves organizing and managing production activities, with a particular emphasis on rural and agricultural sectors. The company also owns and operates hotels and a shopping complex. Initially known as Przedsiebiorstwo Transportu i Uslug 'efekt' S.A., the company officially adopted the name Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt S.A. in 1992.
